newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb-W to vote bonus issue May 30.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb-W to vote bonus issue May 30.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish paintmaker Polifarb Wroclaw SA will vote on May 30 on a bonus issue of 6,375,000 shares which would give them over 50 percent of the new firm after a planned merger with Cieszyn.
Polifarb Wroclaw said in a statement on Thursday that its shareholders would also vote on earmarking 6.4 million zlotys of its 18.5-million-zloty 1996 net profit for dividend.
The extraordinary shareholders meeting was called after the state treasury, a 16-percent shareholder of Wroclaw, demanded changes in the planned merger with Polifarb Cieszyn.
Any shareholder which has more than 10 percent of a company is entitled to request an extraordinary shareholders meeting to vote on its proposals.

The state treasury's demand came as a reaction to Polifarb Cieszyn shareholders' decision to change the conditions of a planned merger by a capital increase, which would give Cieszyn shareholders a bigger stake in the new company.

Cieszyn shareholders approved a version of the merger giving them 53.5 percent rather than 50 percent of the new firm, as originally planned, by increasing a planned pre-merger bonus issue for Cieszyn shareholders to 6.375 from 2.98 million shares.
Cieszyn currently has 19,125,000 shares, 2,978,820 fewer than Wroclaw and a new bonus issue was originally designed to make up for the difference.
